preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of '0's and '1's.

postconditions.description: The output string has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of '0's and '1's.

postconditions.expression: all(max_non_decreasing_subsequence_length(stdin[l:r+1]) == max_non_decreasing_subsequence_length(stdout[l:r+1]) for l in range(len(stdin)) for r in range(l, len(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For any substring of the input and output, the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence is the same.
The number of zeroes in the output string is maximized.
